findings.title: Palestinian dies of wounds sustained in Israeli airstrike on Jabalia in northern Gaza
findings.location: West of Jabalia, northern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: One Palestinian reported to have died from injuries sustained in an Israeli airstrike targeting a group of people; the individual's identity and civilian/combatant status were not verified.
findings.affected_population: Palestinians exposed to airstrikes in the western Jabalia area
findings.affected_system: Civilian protection and casualty reporting; civilian status of the deceased is not independently verified
findings.exact_supporting_passage: A Palestinian succumbed on Monday to wounds sustained in an Israeli airstrike targeting a group of people west of Jabalia, in the northern Gaza Strip.
findings.source_type: Official Palestinian news agency; single-source account, not independently corroborated

discovery_context.verified_from: WAFA publisher article, 9 November 2026, 8:31 PM Palestine local time
discovery_context.duplicate_check: Not in last two authenticated watch heartbeats or previously recorded Gaza City drone-injury, Nuseirat tent-collapse, Rafah medical-evacuation or Deir al-Balah storm incidents.
discovery_context.qualifying_reason: Newly reported fatality outcome with distinct Jabalia location and Israeli airstrike attribution, though original strike date and casualty accounting remain unresolved.
discovery_context.caveat: The publication repeats the earlier aggregate death toll (74,643), so whether this death was already included in prior aggregate figures cannot be determined. No name, precise death time, prior strike date or independent confirmation is supplied.
discovery_context.additional_report_detail: WAFA also notes artillery fire east of Khan Younis but does not document resulting civilian harm there; excluded as a second finding.

coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: OCHA OPT and WHO explicitly checked first. Exactly 12 additional targeted searches, then source-page verification and direct publisher checks. One newly published Palestinian death from wounds sustained in an earlier Israeli airstrike was documented at a distinct location. The underlying strike date and civilian status are unknown. Recurring WHO EMRO, UNRWA and UN News source restrictions warrant DEGRADED status but are not material new deterioration. Remaining independent reporting remained available.
